name: Clinical Notes Summarizer Agent
headline: Turn long source notes into drafts clinicians can verify quickly
pitch: Give clinical teams consistent synthetic encounter, medication, problem-list, and referral-context drafts while keeping diagnosis, treatment, clearance, urgency, scheduling, and record changes with qualified humans.
why_try: The demo shows a transparent summarization pattern: every output separates source facts from clinical interpretation and reminds the reviewer to compare the draft with the authorized record.
customer_challenge: A multispecialty practice faces slow and inconsistent chart review across encounters, medications, problem lists, and referrals, increasing coordination friction and the chance that source details are overlooked.
microsoft_ai_story: Microsoft Copilot Studio provides the conversational experience. Dynamics 365 or an approved healthcare data interface supplies governed clinical context; the package uses fictional records and has no clinical write path.
business_value: Makes source-fact review more consistent across encounter, medication, problem-list, and referral contexts.
Reduces coordination friction by producing concise drafts with explicit source uncertainty.
Protects clinical accountability by reserving diagnosis, treatment, clearance, urgency, and record changes for qualified reviewers.
business_flow: Physicians, surgeons, anesthesia teams, and clinical coordinators
Dynamics 365 or approved read-only healthcare record interface

capabilities.name: Source-grounded encounter summary
capabilities.purpose: Extracts synthetic encounter facts without clinical inference.

capabilities.name: Medication source inventory
capabilities.purpose: Lists source-recorded synthetic medications for clinician or pharmacist reconciliation.

capabilities.name: Problem-list source extract
capabilities.purpose: Extracts source-coded problems without confirming or changing a diagnosis.

capabilities.name: Referral context extract
capabilities.purpose: Summarizes source-recorded referral context without placing or scheduling it.

prompts.label: Summarize the source encounter
prompts.prompt: Summarize synthetic encounter SYN-ENC-001 using source facts only.

recorded_answer.prompt: Summarize synthetic encounter SYN-ENC-001 using source facts only.
recorded_answer.answer:
Here's the source-grounded summary for **SYN-ENC-001** (Synthetic Patient Alpha, 2026-07-28):

- **Visit type:** Follow-up
- **Reported concern:** Knee discomfort with stairs; no trauma noted
- **Recorded vitals/labs:** BP 148/92; HbA1c 8.2%
- No clinical interpretation was made — this is raw source data only, pending clinician review.

This is synthetic demo data, not a real patient record.
